title: Cebu theater group stages Nick Joaquin's final play for Martial Law Literacy Month
summary: A company of Cebuano theater practitioners will mount "Pinoy Agonistes: A History in Two Epochalities," the final play of National Artist for Literature Nick Joaquin, in a rare full-stage advocacy.
